problem:
Evaluate the triple integral 

$$
{∭}_{R}\frac{\operatorname{sin}⁡x\operatorname{cos}⁡y}{{z}^{2}}\,\text{d}V,\,
$$

over the box $R={(x,y,z)\,:\,0\le x\le \pi ,\,0\le y\le \frac{\pi }{2},\,\frac{1}{2}\le z\le 1}.$
worked_solution:
First, we express our triple integral as a repeated integral:

$$
\begin{aligned}{∭}_{R}\frac{\operatorname{sin}⁡x\operatorname{cos}⁡y}{{z}^{2}}\,\text{d}V & ={\int }_{1/2}^{1}{\int }_{0}^{\pi /2}{\int }_{0}^{\pi }\frac{\operatorname{sin}⁡x\operatorname{cos}⁡y}{{z}^{2}}\,\text{d}x\,\text{d}y\,\text{d}z\end{aligned}
$$

Since the domain of integration $R=[0,\pi ]\times [0,\frac{\pi }{2}]\times [\frac{1}{2},1]$ is a rectangular box and the integrand can be expressed as $f(x)\cdot g(y)\cdot h(z),$ we can rewrite our repeated integral as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{1/2}^{1}{\int }_{0}^{\pi /2}{\int }_{0}^{\pi }\frac{\operatorname{sin}⁡x\operatorname{cos}⁡y}{{z}^{2}}\,\text{d}x\,\text{d}y\,\text{d}z & ={\int }_{1/2}^{1}{\int }_{0}^{\pi /2}{\int }_{0}^{\pi }\operatorname{sin}⁡x\cdot \operatorname{cos}⁡y\cdot \frac{1}{{z}^{2}}\,\text{d}y\,\text{d}x\,\text{d}z \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{\pi }\operatorname{sin}⁡x\,\text{d}x{\int }_{0}^{\pi /2}\operatorname{cos}⁡y\,\text{d}y{\int }_{1/2}^{1}\frac{1}{{z}^{2}}\,\text{d}z\end{aligned}
$$

Evaluating each integral separately, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{0}^{\pi }\operatorname{sin}⁡x\,\text{d}x{\int }_{0}^{\pi /2}\operatorname{cos}⁡y\,\text{d}y{\int }_{1/2}^{1}\frac{1}{{z}^{2}}\,\text{d}z & =[-\operatorname{cos}⁡x]_{0}^{\pi }\cdot [\operatorname{sin}⁡y]_{0}^{\pi /2}\cdot {[-\frac{1}{z}]}_{1/2}^{1} \\  & =(1+1)\cdot (1-0)\cdot (-1+2) \\  & =2\cdot 1\cdot 1 \\  & =2.\end{aligned}
$$
